overview: Force Net is a adept-level dark side technique classified under Telekinesis. Weaves strands of dark-side telekinetic energy into a binding net that ensnares and immobilizes multiple targets at once. Sith Inquisitors and Nightsister acolytes deployed Force nets to capture fleeing Jedi and Force-sensitive children for the Empire's Project Harvester.
history:
Force scholars trace Force Net across eras recorded in holocrons, Jedi Archives data-tapes, and Sith tombs on Korriban and Dromund Kaas. Practitioners documented in Rebels · Clone Wars · KOTOR II · The Old Republic established the modern understanding of how this ability manifests in combat, meditation, and ritual.

During the Old Republic and Sith Empire conflicts, masters drilled Force Net into initiates as part of the standard curriculum for telekinesis specialisation. Surviving battle logs from the Clone Wars and Galactic Civil War show the technique adapted to blaster-era warfare, starfighter engagements, and close-quarters lightsaber duels.

In the sequel era, surviving texts and oral traditions kept knowledge of Force Net alive even as the Jedi Temple fell and the Sith assumed new forms. Each generation reinterpreted the power through its own doctrine while the underlying Force mechanism — channelled midi-chlorian symbiosis and focused will — remained constant.

The dark side amplifies this power through passion, anger, and the will to dominate — at the cost of corruption and suffering.
significance:
Force Net exemplifies how telekinesis abilities shape Force doctrine on the dark side. At adept mastery, users balance raw potential against discipline, emotional control, and the moral weight of their choices.

Historians note that armies and orders rose or fell partly on how widely and wisely this technique was taught. A single master of Force Net could turn a skirmish, break a siege, or unravel an enemy's will before blades crossed.

For students today — in academies, hidden enclaves, or alone with ancient texts — Force Net remains a benchmark of telekinesis proficiency across the Star Wars saga.
